stage2_patch.explanation: The /eee/ page is served by PostList, which previously inherited only generic.ListView and therefore returned HTTP 200 to unauthenticated visitors, allowing the vertical privilege escalation. The fix adds Django's built-in LoginRequiredMixin as the first base class on PostList and includes it via the existing Django auth mixins module (django.contrib.auth.mixins), which is the project-appropriate guard context since no custom auth sentinel, role, owner variable, or denial marker exists in the validated snippets. This reuses Django's standard denial semantics: anonymous users are redirected to LOGIN_URL before the queryset is evaluated or any protected content is returned, while authenticated authorized roles (user1, user2) continue to access the list, satisfying both the exploit-block and regression-pass requirements. No other logic, queryset, template, or view was modified, and no role/owner check was added that would over-restrict authorized users.
